page.overview:
What is Long Tall Sally?

This Beatles song from "Long Tall Sally (EP)" and "The Beatles Second Album" is a great classic Beatles song, originally from Little Richard.

The Beatles loved playing this song for their live sets, so it was no surprise that they took it to the studio with them.

The Beatles went into EMI studios to record this classic rocker with Paul on lead vocals and bass, John and George on guitar, Ringo on drums and George Martin on piano, in this song, John plays the first solo, whereas George plays the second.
